source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Removing the MIME_DRAFTS definition and its ifdefs keeps draft support in the compiled source. MimeDisplayOptions still starts with decompose_file_p false and null callback pointers. Draft setup enables that flag and supplies the callbacks. Related-part code keeps its runtime display/decomposition conditions, and its decoded-output branch restores decoder_data after the callback. The removed preprocessor switch does not make every display a draft operation, remove ENABLE_SMIME guards or prove a build or message-processing result.
title: MIME draft decomposition remains a runtime choice after MIME_DRAFTS removal
